name: ironstruct-ue-builder
description: Semantic Unreal structure planning, Grok-assisted art direction, UE MCP operation, collision qualification, and measured lighting review.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and qualify semantic structures in Unreal Engine.
interface.longDescription: A separate Unreal-focused structure workflow for turning art direction into dimensioned semantic plans, Blender exchange assets, guarded UE MCP placements, collision evidence, fixed-scale lighting heatmaps, tester-world iterations, and target-world qualification.
defaultPrompt: Turn this Grok building reference into an IronStruct semantic plan and Unreal tester-world qualification checklist.
Audit this Unreal structure for scale, transforms, collision, runtime duplication, and marker alignment.
Create a fixed-scale lighting heatmap contract and tune this point-light layout without flattening the scene.
Promote this qualified tester-world structure through guarded UE MCP placement and independent saved readback.
